declaration.hypothesis: Only allow the unchanged gold London ORB when the completed native London 08:00-08:15 M15 BID close finishes strictly outside the 00:00-08:00 London Asia M15 BID range, above it for long or below it for short.
declaration.timing: Asia half-open [00:00,08:00) London local; exactly32 consecutive M15 bars required, no missing bars or gaps. Decision uses completed native 08:00 M15 close, before any ORB entry search. Equality, opposite-side close or close within Asia range rejects day. No post-entry/current-day information.
declaration.unchanged: Same original g.replay for all fills, quote-side, costs, virtual BID structural stop, full2R, one attempt, deadline12:00 and EOD16:00. No summer shutdown and no 0.05R cost gate. Filter rejects whole date and no second candidate.
declaration.scope: Post-hoc exploratory hypothesis prompted by prior results; exact rule not previously evaluated in this project, dates were seen in other broad research. Not untouched OOS or prospective.2025 full and Sep-Dec separately, 2026 Jan-Sep partial, all21months only if complete.
declaration.comparison: Paired same date differences Asia-policy minus classic. Rejected otherwise-closed classic entries count zero under Asia policy. Unknown quote/native/Asia coverage excluded from paired estimand and block interval and listed; never imputed. Original classic outcome stays in comparator.
declaration.costs: Use all three frozen1x,1.5x,2x scenarios; 1.5x primary. Same hypothetical commission envelope and assumed 0.05/ounce/side slippage;2025 tariff not verified.
declaration.gates: Do not select threshold or season. Report all periods, every scenario, trade counts, PF, paired delta, 95% circular5weekday bootstrap; separately disclose smallN.
